senses.gloss: m. (v. preced., a. יַבֶּלֶת) a species of grass, Cynodon (Agrostis, v. Sm. Ant. s. v., a. Löw Pfl. p. 183).
units: <cite ref="Avodah Zarah 28a">Ab. Zar. 28ᵃ</cite> bot., v. <cite ref="C00813"><he>גִּירְדָּא</he> I</cite>.—Pl. <he>יַבְלֵי</he>.

<cite ref="Sotah 10a">Sot. 10ᵃ</cite> (quot. Rashi to Ab. Zar. l. c., ed. <cite ref="D00175"><he>דובלא</he></cite>, read: <he>דְּיַ׳</he>); <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 9:50">Num. R. s. 9</cite> (sing.), v. <cite ref="C00813"><he>גִּירְדָּא</he> I</cite>.
Ḥull. 105ᵇ כרך ריפתא אַיַּ׳ (not ליפתא) ate his meal so that the crumbs fell among the yablé.
<cite ref="Chullin 105b:10">Ib.</cite> <he>עקרינהו לְיַ׳ וכ׳</he> he tore the plants out and cast them &c.—
Yoma 78ᵃ בִּדְיַ׳ in shoes made of yablé [Ar. בדיקולי, v. דִּיקוּלָא).
